idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; the runner's half of the columns on worker 0, the peer's on worker 1; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. Cells are integers, a value is one ring push and one ring pop, and a report carries only the cell's index -- the owner reads the finished cell's slot
the runner's half of the columns lives on worker 0 and the peer's on worker 1 at cores=2 -- qb's placement: only the values across the middle column cross a core
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
